scientific_integrity: The unrestricted, all-dimensional, centrally symmetric-base statement is proved analytically; finite tests only corroborate. The cone endpoint is a limit, not a positive-height member.
scientific_limitations: Both apices are axial over the center of a centrally symmetric convex base.
The comparison fixes base and total height; it does not address other deformations.
The formula may overlap uncatalogued earlier special-case results; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Universal John ellipsoids of asymmetric bipyramidal suspensions and a sharp imbalance law
